item.title: Daily News for Sunday, October 25, 2026
item.description: The single story that reorders your Sunday is the BC election: Conservatives have swept to a majority, David Eby has resigned, and Lorne Doerkson becomes premier-elect. For you that is not spectator news — you own property in Sun Peaks, Langley and Vancouver, and a new government...
